description.text: The first expansion pack of the series officially named simply Pokémon Card Game, released on 9 April 2004 and built on the Game Boy Advance games FireRed and LeafGreen. The legendary birds Moltres, Articuno and Zapdos appear as Pokémon ex, and the games' items and characters appear as Trainers. The cards are numbered to 82. In English it became EX FireRed & LeafGreen in September 2004.
